import http.server as s
H = s.SimpleHTTPRequestHandler
_end = H.end_headers
def end_headers(self):
    self.send_header('Cache-Control', 'no-store, must-revalidate')
    _end(self)
H.end_headers = end_headers
s.test(HandlerClass=H, port=8777, bind='127.0.0.1')
